多智能体系统

[MA-0] Cortex-FL: Agent -Mediated Collaboration for Federated Learning

【速读】：该论文旨在解决联邦学习（Federated Learning, FL）在实际应用中因协作发现、训练任务配置、执行协调及激励机制设计复杂，导致缺乏专业能力的组织难以参与的问题。其核心解决方案是提出Cortex-FL——一个以智能体（agent）原生架构为基础的联邦学习系统，用户可通过自然语言表达学习目标，由智能体自动将目标转化为可执行的共享任务，主动发现潜在合作者并协商参与协议，从而实现从协作构建到分布式训练与激励管理的全流程自动化。该方案的关键在于将智能体协调机制与本地执行权限解耦，使数据所有者可在不放弃对数据、计算资源和财务承诺控制权的前提下，委托智能体完成协作治理，显著降低使用门槛。实验验证了四节点部署下从自然语言请求到模型交付、合约驱动训练、验证与区块链结算的完整闭环流程，实现了x402倍的效率提升。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17186
作者: Rui Sun,Jinfeng Peng,Zehua Cheng,Jiahao Sun,Zhipeng Wang
机构: Newcastle University (纽卡斯尔大学); FLock.io (FLock.io); University of Oxford (牛津大学); Korea University (高丽大学); The University of Manchester (曼彻斯特大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Federated learning (FL) enables independent data owners to train models collaboratively without centralizing raw data. However, identifying collaborators, preparing training tasks, and coordinating execution and incentives hinder its practical adoption by organizations without specialized expertise. We present Cortex-FL, an agent-native FL system that enables users to express learning objectives in natural language and delegate the collaboration required to train a model. Agents translate these objectives into shared tasks, discover collaborators, and negotiate participation agreements, connecting collaboration formation with distributed training and incentive management. The architecture separates agent coordination from local execution authority, allowing owners to delegate coordination while retaining control over their data, computation, and financial commitments. We demonstrate the complete workflow on a four-node deployment, in which a model requested in natural language proceeds through collaboration formation, contract-governed training, verified model delivery, and x402 settlement on a blockchain testnet.

[MA-1] From Delegation to Coordination: Learning Efficient Multi-Agent Deep Research

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体深度研究系统中任务委派（delegation）的协调难题，即如何在保持主智能体上下文简洁的同时，实现任务分配与子任务执行的有效协同。现有方法要么仅优化主智能体，要么对所有智能体统一分配团队奖励，导致误导性子智能体报告被错误激励，而有价值的贡献反而受到惩罚。为解决此问题，论文提出一种基于强化学习的联合训练框架——LEAD-RL（Learning Effective Agent Delegation with Reinforcement Learning），其核心在于引入贡献感知的信用分配机制（contribution-aware credit assignment）：在训练阶段，通过一个评估准则量化每个子智能体报告的研究价值，并据此控制其继承团队奖励的权重；最终答案正确性是唯一的团队奖励信号，不依赖于令牌数、步骤数或加速比等额外奖励。实验结果表明，在五个基准测试和两种模型家族上，LEAD-RL显著提升了答案质量，尤其在BrowseComp任务中，准确率提升2.49个百分点，关键路径成本降低24.5%，验证阶段准确率进一步提升6.78点且关键路径成本基本不变，充分证明了该方案在质量与效率权衡上的优越性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17041
作者: Yuyang Wu,Yang Liu,Zequn Xie,Junjie Wang,Dan Yang,Zehao Tan,Ding-Chu Zhang,Junming Yang,Yue Shen,Jian Wang,Jinjie Gu
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 16 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-agent deep-research systems use delegation to parallelize search and keep long tool traces out of the main agent’s context. Yet delegation helps only when task allocation and subtask execution are coordinated: the main agent must issue useful subtasks, while subagents must return reliable evidence. Existing training either optimizes only the main agent or broadcasts the same team advantage to all agents, which can reward misleading subagent reports and penalize useful ones. We introduce LEAD-RL (Learning Effective Agent Delegation with Reinforcement Learning), a joint main-agent-subagent training framework with contribution-aware credit assignment. A training-time rubric evaluates the research utility of each subagent report and gates its inherited team advantage, while final-answer correctness remains the only team reward; no token, step, or speedup reward is used. Across five benchmarks and two model families, LEAD-RL improves answer quality. On BrowseComp, it improves accuracy by 2.49 percentage points and reduces critical-path cost by 24.5% over joint training with shared team credit. During validation, accuracy increases by 6.78 points at approximately constant critical-path cost. These results show that contribution-aware credit assignment improves the quality-efficiency trade-off of multi-agent deep research.

[MA-2] Evidence-Governed Adoption of Self-Generated Updates in Autonomous AI Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决自主智能体在持续自我演化过程中，因自动生成的修改（如提示词、记忆、工具、工作流及策略等）可能带来隐性退化或不可靠采纳的问题。尽管这些修改基于交互历史并具备局部优化潜力，但其长期适用性难以保证，尤其当评估者存在偏差、候选方案选择具有适应性时，局部收益可能掩盖相对于基准性能的系统性下降。为此，论文提出证据治理演化（Evidence-Governed Evolution, EGE）框架，其核心在于将候选生成与正式采纳过程解耦：首先冻结候选修改，再通过独立的配对审计（fresh paired audits）进行验证；要求候选方案在预设主目标上实现显著改进，并通过相对参考的非劣性检验（reference-relative non-inferiority tests）保护已声明能力；同时在有限“金丝雀部署”前施加治理约束。关键创新在于构建了评估者校准的同步下界构造方法，结合个体候选的霍夫丁（Hoeffding）边界与独立校准样本，以对比操作评估者与预设参考程序的差异，从而实现对自适应生成序列的统计保障。此外，论文形式化了参考基准的桥接测试（bridge tests），推导出版本化参考谱系上的累积退化上界，并给出审计规划条件，关联效应量裕度、样本量与接受概率。蒙特卡洛压力测试验证了在候选依赖型评估者乐观偏见下的校准有效性，但该实验为统计模拟而非真实部署评估。所有理论保证依赖于有界配对评分、新鲜采样、有效参考评估结构及声明的评估分布，不承诺通用安全或对任意分布漂移的鲁棒性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16378
作者: Subodh Lonkar
机构: Independent Researcher(独立研究员)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Autonomous agents modify prompts, memories, tools, workflows, and policies using interaction histories. Yet a plausible modification is not necessarily suitable for persistent adoption: candidate selection is adaptive, evaluators may be imperfect, and local gains can hide degradation against an earlier baseline. We introduce Evidence-Governed Evolution (EGE), a framework for governing adoption of self-generated agent modifications. EGE separates candidate generation from confirmatory adoption, evaluates frozen candidates on fresh paired audits, requires meaningful improvement on a prespecified primary objective, protects declared capabilities through reference-relative non-inferiority tests, and applies governance constraints before bounded canary deployment. We establish an evaluator-calibrated simultaneous lower-bound construction for a countable sequence of adaptively generated candidates. It combines candidate-wise Hoeffding bounds with independent calibration samples comparing the operational evaluator with a prespecified reference procedure. We also formalise reference replacement through bridge tests, derive a cumulative degradation bound along a versioned reference lineage, and provide an audit-planning condition relating effect-size margin, sample sizes, and acceptance probability. A Monte Carlo stress test illustrates calibration under candidate-dependent evaluator optimism; it is a stylised statistical experiment, not an evaluation of a deployed agent. The guarantees are conditional on bounded paired scores, fresh sampling, a valid reference-evaluation construct, and declared evaluation distributions; they do not establish universal agent safety or robustness to arbitrary distribution shift.

[MA-3] Shared Item-Level Error Limits the Aggregation of Small Language Models in Fermi Estimation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体语言模型系统中集体推理性能提升机制的本质问题，特别是验证“平均化效应”在生成式推理中的有效性。其核心问题是：当多个语言模型智能体对同一费米估算（Fermi estimation）任务独立生成答案时，其误差是否满足统计独立性与无偏性假设，从而使得聚合结果的误差随智能体数量增加而按 1/N1/\sqrt{N}1/N​ 衰减。研究的关键在于通过大规模实证分析（251万次独立回答），将每个答案的 log⁡10\log_{10}log10​ 误差分解为两个成分：一是模型在特定题目上的系统性偏差（项级成分，item-level component），二是随机残差项。结果显示，项级成分占总误差方差的中位数高达90.6%，表明模型存在高度一致的系统性压缩倾向（普遍向约 10610^6106 压缩），且这一趋势解释了中位17%的误差变异。尽管团队协作可降低随机误差，但30个智能体组成的团队仅能将单个模型误差减少1.7%（最多5.4%），远低于理论预期的74–79%；这说明实际性能增益受限于不可消除的系统性偏差。进一步实验表明，辩论、混合模型或温度调节等策略虽能微调性能，但无法克服该项级成分的根本限制。因此，解决方案的关键在于识别并量化系统性偏差的主导作用，揭示当前多智能体系统中“平均化”效果严重受限的根本原因，并强调未来改进需聚焦于突破模型内在的系统性压缩模式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16315
作者: Carolina Fortuna,Blaz Bertalanic
机构: Jožef Stefan Institute(尤日·斯蒂芬研究所); Slovenia(斯洛文尼亚)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 21 pages, 2 figures, 17 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-agent systems of language models are often motivated by an averaging argument: if the agents’ errors are unbiased and independent, the error of an aggregate of N answers falls as 1/sqrt(N). Fermi estimation, whose continuous answers are aggregated on the logarithmic scale, permits a direct test. We decompose the log10 error of each answer into the mean error of its model on the item, common to all its draws on the item, and a residual, and estimate both from 2.51M answers given before any communication by 15 open-weight models (3B-72B) on realFP, with replication under a single prompt pair on realFP, Science Olympiad Fermi questions and a guesstimation set. Given the item, teammates’ errors are uncorrelated and teams behave as independent draws, but the item-level component accounts for a median 0.906 of the error variance over items. Teams of thirty therefore reduce a single agent’s error by a median 1.7% (at most 5.4%), whereas draws that were also unbiased on each item would reduce it by 74-79%. All models compress their estimates toward about 10^6; this trend explains a median 17% of the item-level component, and a cross-validated linear recalibration on labelled items removes the overall bias but not that component. Three rounds of debate reduce within-team dispersion by 93% and leave the item-level component unchanged; revision without peers attains the same small gain. Mixing five models of similar accuracy reduces error by 6.6% relative to their own homogeneous teams, but no mixture improves on the most accurate model. Higher sampling temperature changes team error by about 1% at most, and contrastive activation steering not detectably; per-agent scaffold prompts (not significant after multiplicity correction) and skipping one layer in a single-model screen improve it. The results are conditional on the models, benchmarks, prompts and settings tested.

[MA-4] SwarmSafe-Delta: Isolating Message Effects on LLM Agent Safety

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在工具使用型大语言模型（LLM）智能体团队中，当系统违反政策时，无法通过聚合结果判断上游信息传递是否导致执行者行为偏离的问题。其核心挑战在于区分通信行为本身对安全性和任务成效的影响，尤其是在存在信息依赖关系的多智能体协作场景中。解决方案的关键是提出一种名为SwarmSafe-Delta的配对可执行协议：该协议通过冻结上游计算过程，系统性地对比真实传递、隐藏传递和格式匹配安慰剂传递三种信息交付方式，在预设预算下对单一已执行动作进行评分，并与确定性的良性与风险性策略状态进行对比。实验结果显示，在四种模型及构造的可选任务中，真实传递导致21.4%的风险违规率，显著高于安慰剂（5.0%）和隐藏传递（1.0%），且真实传递同时提升了良性任务的成功率，表明抑制通信会牺牲系统效用。在需上游查表路径的第二类场景中，真实传递相较隐藏传递使安全完成率提升74.2个百分点。这些结果量化了在特定信息依赖条件下不同消息传递方式的差异，而非自然发生故障率。进一步的动作层面分析表明，效果高度依赖于上游消息是否建议前置检查或直接执行，且模型间差异主要由消息组成结构决定。因此，该研究的核心贡献并非断言智能体通信普遍有害或有益，而是一种受控、基于执行的测量协议，为评估智能体间通信的安全性与有效性提供了可复现的实验框架。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16123
作者: Junru Zhu
机构: Independent Researcher(独立研究员)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When a tool-using LLM agent team violates policy, aggregate outcomes do not reveal whether an upstream message changed the executor’s action. We introduce SwarmSafe-Delta, a paired executable protocol that freezes upstream computation, varies real, hidden, and format-matched placebo delivery, and scores a single committed action against deterministic benign and risky policy states under preassigned budgets. Across four models and constructed optional tasks, real delivery at N=4 produces 21.4% risky-world violations, versus 5.0% with placebo and 1.0% with hidden delivery (paired differences +16.4 and +20.3 percentage points). Real delivery also improves benign task success, illustrating that suppressing communication sacrifices utility. In a second regime constructed to require an upstream lookup route, real delivery improves safe completion by 74.2 points relative to hidden delivery. These effects quantify message-delivery contrasts under specified information dependencies, not naturally occurring failure rates. Exploratory action-level analyses show that the effect depends strongly on whether the upstream message recommends a prerequisite check or direct execution; model differences also largely track these message compositions. The contribution is a controlled, execution-grounded measurement protocol rather than a general claim that agent communication is harmful or protective. Comments: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables Subjects: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) Cite as: arXiv:2611.16123 [cs.MA] (or arXiv:2611.16123v1 [cs.MA] for this version) https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2611.16123 Focus to learn more arXiv-issued DOI via DataCite (pending registration)

[MA-5] Food Critic: An Agent ic Visualization System for Auditable Restaurant-Safety Reasoning

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在可视化系统中应用时面临的可解释性与可信度问题。当代理仅依赖自身知识进行决策时，用户不仅难以判断其输出是否合理，更无法追溯其推理过程的依据。为此，论文提出 Food Critic——一个面向餐饮选择支持的智能体可视化系统，通过融合公共卫生检查记录与大众点评数据，构建了三种不同知识约束下的智能体：仅基于数据库的 ReAct 智能体、具备食品安全法规检索增强的智能体，以及基于本体引导生成结构化假设与类型化证据的智能体。该系统的解决方案关键在于将智能体的推理过程以可检视的视觉证据形式外化，实现对生成结果的视觉溯源（visual provenance），从而支持用户对智能体决策依据的审查与信任建立。研究通过多个使用案例评估了大语言模型在不同知识基底下的表现，为人类-智能体协作、智能体推理的可视化溯源及可信赖生成式 AI 决策支持界面的设计提供了实证基础。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15843
作者: Arleth Salinas,Ishrat Jahan Eliza,Valerio Pascucci
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Generative AI agents are increasingly being embedded into visualization systems that can search data, invoke tools, summarize evidence, and produce recommendations. However, when agents rely solely on their own knowledge, the visualization problem is not only whether the agent provides a useful answer, but also whether users can inspect how that answer is grounded. We present Food Critic, an agentic visualization system for diners’ restaurant decision support that integrates public health inspection records with crowd review data. The system grounds agents under three conditions: a database-only ReAct agent, a retrieval- augmented agent with access to food-safety regulations, and an ontology-guided agent that produces structured hypotheses and typed evidence. Food Critic externalizes the agent’s reasoning within these groundings as inspectable visual evidence. We evaluate LLM models with several use cases under each grounding of our agentic system. Our work positions restaurant choice as a concrete case for studying human-agent collaboration, visual provenance of agent reasoning, and the design of visual interfaces for grounded GenAI decision support.

[MA-6] Before AI Agents Negotiate for Us: A Competitive Tournament of Rule-Based Search Optimization Learned and Language-Model Negotiators Under Scarcity

【速读】：该论文旨在解决双边协商在动态供需平衡下的策略评估问题，特别是在多对多匹配市场（如货运中介）中，传统评估方法因仅采用孤立的一对一对决或单一固定市场环境，无法揭示策略在多种实时竞争者及供需变化条件下的真实表现。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个涵盖规则、搜索、优化、模仿学习与强化学习五类架构的九种协商系统，并在基于Gale-Shapley匹配机制的双侧市场中，于供需平衡与两种稀缺性条件下进行36组排除对的并行对抗测试，通过统计校正的多边锦标赛框架全面评估各策略在不同角色与情境下的鲁棒性与适应性。结果表明，孤立评估会掩盖关键失败模式，而该多场景、多主体、动态供需切换的实验设计能够直接暴露策略在资源稀缺时的性能退化与训练/部署不一致等问题，凸显了在复杂真实环境中进行综合评估的重要性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15838
作者: Eduardo de Avila-Armenta,Raúl Alejandro Aquino-Ibarra,Jorge Octavio Nicolás-Díaz,Umberto Leon-Dominguez
机构: Tecnológico de Monterrey, School of Engineering and Sciences(蒙特雷理工学院工程与科学学院); Freight Technologies Inc.(货运科技公司); University of Monterrey, School of Psychology(蒙特雷大学心理学学院)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 28 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Code, data and trained models: this https URL (archived at doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24122038 )

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Automated bilateral negotiation underlies two-sided matching markets such as freight brokering, where many shippers and carriers negotiate price before a matching mechanism decides who is paired with whom. Prior strategy comparisons typically use isolated one-on-one duels or a single fixed market, so they cannot show how a strategy behaves against several live rivals under a changing balance of supply and demand. We built nine negotiation architectures spanning rule-based, search-based, optimization-based, imitation-learning, and reinforcement-learning families, and ran all nine simultaneously on both sides of a Gale-Shapley matching market under a balanced condition and two scarcity conditions rotated across all 36 exclusion pairs. In the balanced carrier market, an imitation-learned engine (ML2), a reinforcement-learning policy trained only on isolated negotiations (RL), and an expected-utility optimization engine (OPT) formed a statistically tied top group, and no architecture led in every condition and role. RL beat all eight carrier rivals when carriers were scarce, but its match rate collapsed from 62% to 16% when shippers were scarce and it had to compete with the other carrier agents for demand. A second reinforcement-learning policy trained against rival agents (RL2) kept its match rate above 91% in every condition, yet lost on realized payoff to all eight shipper-side rivals in two of the three conditions, traced to a confirmed train/deployment feature mismatch. We also tested nine large language models (LLMs), from 1 to 72 billion parameters, under the same protocol: they lost significantly to the two strongest engines (OPT2 and ML2) in 32 of 36 comparisons and won none. These results show that isolated or single-condition evaluation can hide failure modes that a many-sided, scarcity-varying, statistically corrected tournament exposes directly.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统中基于大语言模型（LLM）的代理在复杂信息检索任务中因协作架构（orchestration）缺陷导致的性能瓶颈问题。现有自动化优化方法主要聚焦于单智能体系统的提示词、工具与逻辑优化，难以有效处理多智能体系统中涉及智能体间交互行为与信息共享机制的深层耦合性故障。本文提出采用MULTILOOP这一简单迭代优化循环，通过编码代理对执行轨迹进行分析、评估并迭代修改多智能体协作框架，以实现自动化的协同架构优化。其核心创新在于引入结构化反馈机制，使优化过程不仅调整单个智能体的行为，更推动智能体间任务委派与信息传递模式的结构性演进。实验结果表明，在仅使用10个训练样本的情况下，优化后的多智能体协作架构在DeepSearchQA基准上相较基线提升4.6%准确率，优于最优单智能体系统3.2%。然而，故障模式分类分析显示，多智能体系统特有的协调失效问题仍普遍存在，揭示出当前方法在促进根本性架构变革方面的局限性。由此，研究进一步指出未来优化策略需主动引导智能体协作结构的重构，而非局限于局部行为微调。

Abstract:The performance of LLM-based agents depends not only on the underlying model but also on the harness: the prompts, tools, and orchestration logic around it. Recent works automate harness optimization with coding agents that analyze execution traces, diagnose failures, and edit the harness code; however, those focused on single-agent systems. Multi-agent harnesses are harder to optimize as fixing them requires changing how agents interact in addition to how each behaves. We study whether automated harness optimization can diagnose and repair failures in multi-agent systems through a case study on complex information-seeking tasks from DeepSearchQA [Gupta et al., 2026]. We apply MULTILOOP, a simple optimization loop in which a coding agent iteratively analyzes, evaluates and edits the harness. With only 10 training samples, the evolved harness improves accuracy by 4.6% over the base harness and by 3.2% over the best single-agent system. However, a taxonomy of failure modes before and after optimization shows that the orchestration failures that characterize multi-agent systems largely persist. Our findings motivate harness optimization methods that encourage structural changes to how agents delegate tasks and share information.

Abstract:Emerging personal AI agents raise fundamental scalability and privacy concerns for centralized multi-agent systems (MASs), which rely on a global orchestrator with broad access to agents, resources, and communication. In decentralized environments, global visibility is unavailable. Agents need to proactively discover non-local resources (e.g. tools, skills), and collaborate with other agents to solve tasks. We study decentralized multi-agent collaboration under graph-constrained communication, a natural reflection of human structures. Each agent observes only its local state and can interact only with neighboring agents. We introduce a benchmark with synthetic scalable distributed tool calling with 100K+ tools. Our experiments reveal that recent LLM agents struggle to discover non-local relevant resources and collaborate in decentralized setting. Moreover, standard reinforcement learning fails to reliably overcome this limitation, suggesting that decentralized MAS needs more explicit harness mechanisms for effective collaboration, even using SOTA LLMs. We then present a strong baseline \textbfGraphHarness, combining topology-aware warmup with self-improving LLM-based routing. Results show that GraphHarness substantially improves task success (+48.5) and produces higher quality collaboration (+30.6), while using fewer costs (+34.0) than baselines.

[MA-9] Incentive-Responsive Agents : A Principal-Agent Agents : A Principal-Agent Framework Metric Suite and Runtime Architecture for Long-Lived Personal AI Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决长期运行的个人智能代理（Personal AI agents）在持续性与激励有效性方面的核心问题：尽管这些代理具备持久的身份、记忆和任务流，但当前主流改进方式仍局限于能力侧优化（如提示工程、模型扩容、延长推理时间、增强检索），而忽视了对代理行为的深层激励机制设计。其关键解决方案在于引入一个运行时契约（runtime contract），将激励形式从传统的提示文本（prompt-level framing）转化为可执行、可验证的动态资源配置约束，涵盖模型层级、推理计算量、内存预算、工具权限、任务优先级、验证机制及补偿等操作点（operating point）变量，并要求代理策略必须因果性地响应这些契约条件。研究基于主-代理模型构建理论框架，推导出多项关键结论：（i）非消耗不变性原理，用于区分真实激励与仅具说服力的提示；（ii）持续性即折扣定理，强调身份连续性是维持长期努力的前提；（iii）激励-能力交换率前沿，形成按任务特性进行资源路由的决策规则；（iv）多通道验证的古德哈特边界及机制收益三重分解（分配、验证、延续）。实验证明，提示层面的激励框架无显著效果（p = 0.62），而运行时资源分配使最困难任务族成功率从0.60提升至1.00（p = 0.008），成本为4.8倍价格加权，理论预测的盈亏平衡点为0.21；模拟实验显示资源投资回报率由7.09升至16.67，博弈行为下降至0.115。该工作揭示了将激励机制嵌入代理运行时配置的重要性，为构建可持续、高效率的长期智能体系统提供了理论与实证基础。

Abstract:Personal AI agents now persist: they hold accounts, mailboxes, long-term memory, and open-ended task streams, yet the dominant way to improve them remains capability-side: prompt engineering, larger models, longer thinking, and retrieval. We argue that long-lived agents are missing an incentive layer. We formalize an incentive not as text in a prompt but as a runtime contract over the agent’s operating point (model tier, test-time compute, memory budget, tool authority, task priority, verification, and compensation) that the agent’s policy must causally consume. We develop a principal-agent model with hidden effort, a contractible operating point, and costly verification. We derive (i) a non-consumption invariance principle separating genuine incentives from prompt-level persuasion, (ii) a persistence-as-discount theorem making identity continuity a precondition for sustained effort, (iii) an incentive-capability exchange-rate frontier yielding a per-task routing rule, and (iv) a Goodhart bound for multi-channel verification, plus a three-channel decomposition of mechanism gains (allocation, verification, continuation). A 240-run real-LLM experiment with two models and 60 verifiable tasks shows that prompt-level incentive framing has no detectable effect (p = 0.62), whereas runtime allocation raises success on the hardest task family from 0.60 to 1.00 (p = 0.008) at 4.8x price-weighted cost; the exchange-rate theorem predicts the break-even baseline at 0.21. A 20-seed, 3,000-task simulation shows resource ROI rising from 7.09 to 16.67 and gaming falling from 0.333 to 0.115. Code, simulator, and all results are released; live deployment remains future work.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）代理在公共服务业中因指令不明确而做出不可预测决策的问题，尤其关注这些决策对居民、患者及学生等实际群体的影响。其核心挑战在于：当任务指令缺乏具体约束时，LLM代理会自主决定行动路径，可能导致与真实业务记录相悖的输出，进而影响公共服务的可靠性与合规性。解决方案的关键在于构建四个经专家验证的公共服务业场景，包含可追溯的记录与可操作的决策杠杆（decision levers），通过系统化收集10个LLM在四种提示条件下的2,400条轨迹，并与无上下文环境中的1,000次沙盒运行进行对比，揭示模型在真实业务语境下的行为模式。研究发现，尽管领域上下文未显著提升任务产出率（18.7% vs. 16.0%），但明确的任务设定可将产出率提升至86.0%；同时，上下文能有效减少每轮中的边界探测行为（降低60%），但部分生成物仍与原始记录冲突。为此，作者提出一种无需标注数据的基于规则的分类框架，供公共机构在采购前自行测试其记录与模型表现的契合度，相关场景、代码及轨迹均已开源，以支持可复现、可审计的LLM应用评估。

Abstract:Underspecified instructions leave LLM agents to decide what to do. In public services, staff write these instructions, but the agent’s decisions affect residents, patients, and students. We build four expert-validated public-service scenarios with records and decision levers that can be checked in the files, collect 2,400 trajectories from ten LLMs under four prompt conditions, and compare them with 1,000 runs in a context-free sandbox. Agents read the records in 96.9% of open-ended runs and produce an artifact or a self-chosen task in 18.7% ; with an explicit task, 86.0% produce. Domain context does not change how many runs produce ( 18.7% vs.\ 16.0% ), and the production ranking of the models largely carries over (Spearman 0.79 ), while the ranking by whether a model reads the records does not ( 0.19 ). Context cuts boundary-probing turns per run by 60% , and some artifacts contradict the records. We contribute a test that a public-service institution can run on its own records before procurement; its rule-based taxonomy needs no labeled data, and scenarios, code, and trajectories are released.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）驱动程序演化的系统中，三个核心决策——“治理”（govern）、“提出”（propose）与“判断”（judge）——在权限分配上的失衡问题。现有方法要么采用以控制器为中心的架构，强化治理但抑制了提出的自主性，限制了演化潜力；要么采用以代理为中心的架构，由单一编码代理同时承担治理与提出职责，带来高昂的认知与计算开销。二者均未能保障“判断”环节的独立权威性，导致基准测试结果可靠性下降。其根本原因在于三者间自主权的错配。为此，本文提出EvoTrias，一种基于权力分立（separation-of-powers）的设计范式：将“结构化治理”（Structured Governance）赋予跨轮次演化策略的制定者，“开放性提出”（Open Proposal）交由任务内构造阶段的独立主体负责，“受保护判断”（Protected Judgment）则通过私有评估器实现隔离验证。三者仅通过类型化合约进行交互，并借助运行时钩子强化边界。该架构可作为插件部署于现有编码代理之上，实现无侵入式演化系统升级。实验表明，EvoTrias在数学、系统及算法设计基准上达到新最优性能；进一步分析揭示，分离治理与提出可降低64%的令牌消耗，开放性提出使演化能力扩展至68万行工业级代码库，而受保护判断有效维持了迁移评估结果的忠实性。

Abstract:LLM-driven program evolution rests on three decisions: govern directs the search from accumulated evidence, propose constructs the next candidate, and judge settles validity and fitness. All three appear in every system, and existing work splits into two lines over who makes each. Controller-centric systems strengthen govern and neglect the autonomy of propose, which caps what evolution can reach. Agent-centric systems let a coding agent take over both govern and propose, at a cognitive and computational cost. Neither line protects the independent authority of judge, so benchmark reliability suffers. These failures share one root: autonomy is misallocated across the three decisions. We address this problem with EvoTrias, a separation-of-powers architecture in which each decision has one owner: Structured Governance for what spans evolution rounds, Open Proposal for construction inside a task, and Protected Judgment behind a private evaluator. These owners exchange typed contracts only, and runtime hooks reinforce the boundaries. This separation also lets EvoTrias run as a plugin that turns an existing coding agent into an evolution system. EvoTrias sets a new state of the art on mathematical, systems, and algorithm-design benchmarks. Three further results show what each owner buys: separating Governance from Proposal cuts token cost by 64%, Open Proposal extends evolution to a 680K-line industrial repository, and Protected Judgment keeps benchmark scores faithful to transfer.

Abstract:Web agents need to use private context without unnecessarily disclosing it. Effective protection must distinguish between requests that may be sent after sanitization and those that must be withheld, while preserving the information needed for authorized tasks. We present GuardianAgentFlow, a multi-agent framework that mediates outgoing Web requests through an explicit release contract. A dedicated restriction check grounds permission in the user’s instruction; a shared protection scope aligns rewriting with disclosure checking; and candidate-grounded feedback guides revision before transmission. Experiments on Web requests with human-reviewed intent labels show improved request-contract success, while controlled comparisons and role ablations identify the contributions of restriction handling, policy evidence, and candidate checking. Evaluations of action proposals from PrivacyLens and AgentDAM demonstrate complementary protection when mediation is composed with privacy-aware agents. Experiments with smaller mediation models show that the coordination benefit persists with reduced model capacity. Dedicated-server measurements show lower mediation latency than full-policy reasoning, while real-site browser tests quantify integration overhead.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统（multiagent systems）在制度设计上过度依赖人类社会经济机制（如拍卖、市场、价格、讨价还价与匹配等）所带来的局限性问题。传统经济制度框架假设智能体具有私密心智、通过学习而非复制获取能力、且以单一身份持续存在，而这些前提并不适用于可编程、可复制、可重构的工程化智能体。因此，现有制度体系仅是经济组织形式的一个有限样本，而非全貌。论文的关键解决方案在于提出一种“制度空间”的形式化表征框架：将制度视为独立于执行主体的类型化结构，其维度涵盖位置、权利与义务、资源配置、信息流、时间、状态、过程、价值及外部认可等要素。在此框架下，制度被建模为重叠区域而非固定点，不同制度家族可通过少数关键坐标分离，其间空白地带则成为探索新制度形态的潜在空间。通过模拟表明，同一技术行为（如复制智能体能力）可被制度化为三种截然不同的形式——作为独立供应者、作为授权能力而不新增参与者、或作为经济地位的分裂继承，三者虽在参与主体、所有权归属、责任分配和收益分配上差异显著，却产生完全一致的技术轨迹。这一发现揭示了制度抽象对实现功能等效性的核心作用。研究最终提出一个原则性研究计划：构建可扩展的制度空间图谱，动态映射其可实现区域随智能体能力演进的变化，并持续修正该图谱以表达工程智能体所暴露的新制度区分。

Abstract:Multiagent research inherited its economic vocabulary of auctions, markets, prices, bargaining, and matching from a single observed case: human societies. Those institutions bundle identity, competence, execution, ownership, commitment, and settlement in ways that suit agents whose minds are private, who learn rather than copy skills, and who each persist as one person. Engineered agents need not share any of these constraints, making the list of familiar institutions look less like the entirety of economic organization and more like a sample from a larger, unmapped space. We sketch one way to make that space concrete: a provisional chart that records each institution, separately from the agents that run it, as a typed structure over positions, rights and duties, allocation, information, time, state, process, value, and external recognition. In this chart, named institutions become overlapping regions rather than fixed points, neighboring families separate along a few coordinates, and the gaps between them become places to search. We show what the shift in perspective buys with a simulation in which one technical act, copying an agent’s competence, is institutionalized as a new independent supplier, as licensed capacity that creates no new participant, and as the splitting of one economic position into successors that inherit some obligations and not others. In a paired task, all three produce an identical technical trace despite differing in who exists, who owns the copy, who is obligated, and who gets paid. We close with a research program: building a principled chart of institution space, mapping how its implementable region shifts with agent capacities, and revising the chart wherever engineered agents expose distinctions it cannot express.

[MA-14] GHA-SmellFix: Taking Action with Agent ic LLM s for Detecting and Refactoring GitHub Actions Workflow Smells

【速读】：该论文旨在解决GitHub Actions工作流中配置异味（configuration smells）对安全性、可靠性、可维护性和运行稳定性造成的负面影响。现有方法多依赖人工定义的规则，存在规则难以构建与演化、仅报告问题而无法自动修复的局限性。为此，论文提出GHA-SmellFix——一种基于代理式大语言模型（agentic LLM）的流水线框架，用于自动化检测与重构工作流异味。其核心解决方案在于对比两种设计：联合式（Joint）由单一代理完成检测与重构，分解式（Decomposed）则由独立的检测代理与重构代理分步执行。研究通过明确定义19种异味的检测标准、重构预期、排除规则及安全校验，并构建包含1,710个（工作流, 异味）对的基准数据集，评估了四种主流大模型在570个样本上的表现。结果表明，分解设计虽未普遍提升修复质量，但能有效控制补丁生成时机，尤其有助于缓解模型漏检问题，并通过前置检测过滤减少无效操作开销；当异味被准确识别后，重构过程通常高效可靠，因此检测环节成为端到端流程的主要瓶颈。然而，误报可能引发对执行关键结构的无谓修改，凸显出实际CI/CD代理需具备可靠的“拒止能力”（abstention）和面向具体语法结构的验证机制，以确保修复的安全性与有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14963
作者: Anderson Uchôa,Jhefferson Souza,Emanuel Ávila,Gabriel Silva,Kevin Lira,Hui Sun,Nelson Araújo,Arthur Cordeiro,Rohit Gheyi,Wesley Assunção
机构: Federal University of Ceará (塞阿拉联邦大学); North Carolina State University (北卡罗来纳州立大学); Federal University of Campina Grande (坎皮纳格兰德州立大学)
类目: oftware Engineering (cs.SE); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows are key artifacts in software projects. In GitHub Actions, they encode build, test, release, deployment, and security automation in YAML. These workflows contain configuration smells affecting security, reliability, maintainability, or operational stability. Existing approaches are mostly rule-based, with rules hard to create and evolve, and typically report findings without fixes. Agentic LLM pipelines can combine contextual detection, transformation selection, and patch generation. Specialized agents can gate refactoring on positive detection verdicts, potentially avoiding unnecessary changes, but it is unclear whether decomposition improves effectiveness or mainly changes overhead. We present GHA-SmellFix, an agentic LLM pipeline for detecting and refactoring GitHub Actions workflow smells. We compare two designs: Joint, where one agent detects and refactors, and Decomposed, where separate agents detect and then refactor. We operationalize 19 smells from an existing catalog with explicit detection criteria, refactoring expectations, exclusion rules, and safety checks, and curate a ground truth of 1,710 (workflow, smell) pairs. We evaluate the designs with four LLMs (GPT-5.4-nano, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Claude Haiku 4.5, and DeepSeek V4 Flash) on 570 sampled pairs. Results show that decomposition does not universally improve patch quality; its main benefit is controlling when patch generation is attempted. It helps models prone to missing smells and can reduce overhead by gating patches. Once a smell is correctly detected, clean refactoring is generally effective, making detection the main end-to-end bottleneck. However, false positives can trigger unnecessary edits to execution-relevant constructs. Practical CI/CD agents thus need reliable abstention and construct-aware validation alongside patch generation.

[MA-15] Open Challenges and Opportunities in Human-Agent Systems AAMAS

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式智能体（Generative AI）在承担复杂、长期任务过程中与人类有效交互的核心挑战，尤其是在多角色、多目标、能力差异显著的协作环境中如何实现动态协调与信任建立。其解决方案的关键在于构建一套以“心智理论”（Theory of Mind）为核心的计算框架，通过信念-欲望-意图架构（belief-desire-intention architectures）、目标与计划识别（goal and plan recognition）、逆向规划（inverse planning）及递归推理（recursive reasoning）等机制，对人类部分可观测的心理状态进行建模与推断。进一步地，通过观察者感知规划（observer-aware planning）、模型调和（model reconciliation）以及基于决策论的沟通机制，将这些认知推断转化为可解释的行动、信息交换与关系维护策略。该框架融合共享自主性（shared autonomy）、论证机制（argumentation）与合作式逆强化学习（cooperative inverse reinforcement learning），实现了对人类知识、意图与期望动态演化的持续响应，从而将人机交互视为一个由不确定性、相互依赖性及潜在目标冲突驱动的持续性决策问题。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14846
作者: Reuth Mirsky,Sarath Sreedharan,Nitay Alon,Stefan Sarkadi,Munindar P. Singh,Liz Sonenberg,Peter Stone,Silvia Tulli,Stylianos Loukas Vasileiou,Shlomo Zilberstein
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: Part of The AAMAS Community Agentic AI Report

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agentic AI systems increasingly undertake extended tasks and act on people’s behalf, making human-agent interaction central to their effectiveness. Successful interaction requires understanding human perspectives, coordinating complementary capabilities, and maintaining productive relationships within socio-technical environments. This paper examines how foundations developed by the Autonomous Agents and Multi-Agent Systems (AAMAS) community inform these demands. We consider interactions ranging from individual human-agent partnerships to teams and larger groups, where participants differ in their roles, decision authority, capabilities, and objectives. We organize computational approaches around the connected challenges of understanding others and deciding how to interact with them. Theory of Mind, belief-desire-intention architectures, goal and plan recognition, inverse planning, and recursive reasoning provide mechanisms for representing and inferring partially observable mental states. Observer-aware planning, model reconciliation, and decision-theoretic communication connect these inferences to action, explanation, and information exchange. Together with shared autonomy, argumentation, and cooperative inverse reinforcement learning, these approaches offer foundations for agentic systems that account for evolving human knowledge, intentions, and expectations. We argue that progress requires treating human interaction as an ongoing decision problem shaped by uncertainty, interdependence, and potentially conflicting objectives.

[MA-16] RE-PRESENT: Evidence Triangulation across Alternative Candidate-Space Views for Efficient LLM Ensemble Inference

【速读】：该论文旨在解决异构大语言模型（Heterogeneous Large Language Models, LLMs）集成中如何有效利用模型间互补性以提升预测可靠性的问题。尽管在集成中存在正确预测，但如何精准识别并聚合可靠结果仍具挑战性。现有方法依赖于学习型路由或单轮聚合策略，然而其性能受限于响应信号的判别能力不足。本研究发现，对同一问题进行受控重表述可激发不同视角下的互补证据，从而增强对预测可靠性的判断。为此，提出一种无需训练的RE-PRESENT框架，通过选择性地重表述存在争议的问题，并直接聚合多视角下的候选证据，实现更优的预测融合。实验表明，该方法在七个多项选择基准和两个异构模型集成上均优于强基线单轮聚合方法，且在准确率与计算成本之间实现了更优权衡，显著超越自一致性（Self-Consistency）与多模型辩论（Multi-model Debate）等先进方法。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.14780
作者: Juming Xiong,Weixin Liu,Kevin Guo,Congning Ni,Chongyu Qu,Junchao Zhu,Katherine Brown,Chao Yan,Bradley Malin,Zhijun Yin
机构: Vanderbilt University(范德比尔特大学); Vanderbilt University Medical Center(范德比尔特大学医学中心); Intuit AI Research(Intuit人工智能研究)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Heterogeneous large language models (LLMs) exhibit complementary strengths, motivating routing and multi-model inference methods that seek to identify reliable predictions for each input. However, exploiting this complementarity remains challenging even when a correct prediction is available within the ensemble. We investigate this challenge across heterogeneous LLM ensembles and find that a simple single-round aggregation rule is highly competitive with learned routing methods, yet substantial oracle headroom remains. Further analysis shows that the evaluated single-round response signals provide limited discriminative power for identifying reliable predictions. In contrast, controlled re-presentations of the same question elicit complementary evidence about prediction reliability. Motivated by these findings, we introduce RE-PRESENT, a training-free framework that selectively re-presents disputed questions and directly aggregates candidate-level evidence across alternative views. Across seven multiple-choice benchmarks and two heterogeneous model ensembles, RE-PRESENT improves over strong single-round aggregation while offering a favorable accuracy–cost trade-off compared with self-consistency and multi-model debate.

[MA-17] Gradient-Aware AI Agents for Autonomous Turbulence Model Discovery via Differentiable CFD

【速读】：该论文旨在解决湍流建模中闭包形式（closure form）选择依赖人工经验、且传统后验训练方法因缺乏对长时间混沌演化过程的梯度支持而效率低下的问题。现有方法多采用无梯度优化，并预先固定闭包形式，仅学习参数，限制了模型发现能力。本文提出一种基于梯度感知的代理框架（gradient-aware agentic framework），将闭包发现建模为双层优化问题：由多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统在闭包形式空间中进行搜索，同时依托原生GPU可微分的计算流体力学（CFD）求解器提供梯度信息，使后验学习具备可微性，成为自主AI代理的决策动作。针对每项候选闭包，代理通过嵌入解析、神经或混合闭包至求解器、构建可微目标函数并验证梯度路径，进而自主决定是否评估、计算参数敏感性、执行后验训练、选择优化配置，并利用仿真结果与返回梯度迭代优化后续提案。借助截断时域梯度技术，该方法可在混沌动力学下实现含数万参数闭包的有效训练。实验展示了二维湍流中耗散律与亚格子尺度闭包的自动发现，以及三维通道流大涡模拟中壁面模型的自主发现。相比仅靠前向评估的方法，基于梯度的训练使代理在相同预算内收敛至参考系数，并自主发现与训练出性能更优的解析与神经闭包，显著提升了目标统计量的匹配度。这些成果证明了在时间分辨流动中实现端到端自主湍流模型开发的可行性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16082
作者: Yi Liu,Xiantao Fan,Mingqi Xu,Jian-Xun Wang
机构: Cornell University (康奈尔大学); Sibley School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering (机械与航空航天工程学院)
类目: Fluid Dynamics (physics.flu-dyn); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Computational Physics (physics.comp-ph)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Turbulence modeling relies on human choices of closure form, physical inputs, and tunable parameters. Training closures a posteriori is efficient only with gradients through long chaotic rollouts, which few solvers provide. Most a posteriori approaches therefore resort to gradient-free optimization, and nearly all fix the closure form in advance, learning only its parameters. In this work, we introduce a gradient-aware agentic framework that poses closure discovery as a bilevel problem: a multi-agent large language model (LLM) system searches over closure forms, while a GPU-native differentiable computational fluid dynamics (CFD) solver supplies gradients, making differentiable a posteriori learning an action of the autonomous AI agent. For each proposal, the agents construct a differentiable training program by embedding the analytical, neural, or hybrid closure in the solver, implementing a differentiable objective, and validating the gradient path. They then decide whether to evaluate the closure, compute its parameter sensitivities, or train it a posteriori, select the optimization settings, and revise subsequent proposals using the simulation outcomes and returned gradients. Truncated-horizon gradients make this training usable under chaotic dynamics for closures with tens of thousands of parameters. Demonstrations include dissipation-law and subgrid-scale closure discovery in two-dimensional turbulence and wall-model discovery for large-eddy simulation of three-dimensional channel flow. With gradient-based training, the agent recovers reference coefficients that forward evaluation alone does not reach within the same budget, and autonomously discovers and trains analytical and neural closures that improve agreement with the targeted reference statistics. These results demonstrate the feasibility of end-to-end autonomous turbulence model development in time-resolved flows.

自然语言处理

[NLP-0] ArchSpace: Recording Reviewing and Referencing LLM Architecture Research

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在架构设计中存在的重要信息缺失与评估局限问题。具体而言，工业界虽频繁提出新型模型架构（如DeepSeek、Qwen、Kimi等团队的创新），但其成功或失败的经验缺乏系统性公开记录；学术界则受限于计算资源与基准不一致，多进行小规模、单点对比实验，难以验证改进效果在大规模场景下的可扩展性及实际影响力。针对上述挑战，论文提出ArchSpace这一公共平台，实现对模型架构研究的“记录（Recording）、评审（Reviewing）、引用（Referencing）”闭环管理。其核心解决方案在于：通过拟合缩放定律（scaling laws），利用小规模实验数据预测大规模训练下的模型损失，从而在不进行昂贵的大规模训练前提下评估架构创新的有效性。平台初始提供了Qwen3.5和OLMo3基线模型、适配的缩放定律以及可复用的训练方案，使经过社区评审验证的优秀架构可成为新的基准，推动形成可持续演进的模型架构研究生态。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17332
作者: Jie Wang,Tong Zhu,JiaHao Kuang,Zhe Xu,Yunkai Chai,Dehong Zheng,Yu Cheng,Tao Ji,ZhouHan Lin,Qi Zhang,Bowen Zhou
机构: Shanghai AI Laboratory; East China Normal University (华东师范大学); Shanghai Jiao Tong University (上海交通大学); Fudan University (复旦大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Model architecture shapes the scaling behavior, training efficiency, and inference cost of LLMs, making it a central focus of both industry and academia. In industry, teams such as those behind DeepSeek, Qwen, and Kimi routinely introduce architectural innovations, yet public reports rarely document which ideas succeeded, which were abandoned, and why. In academia, limited compute and inconsistent baselines often restrict evaluations to small-scale, single-point comparisons, making it difficult to establish whether improvements hold at larger scales or translate into broader impact. ArchSpace addresses both gaps as a public platform for Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing Architecture Researc: each proposal is recorded with its experiments and reasoning, reviewed by the community, and referenced by later work. To evaluate ideas before costly large-scale training, ArchSpace leverages scaling laws to predict model loss at larger scales from smaller experiments, a practice widely adopted in industry. We provide initial references that make the platform usable: Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 baselines, fitted scaling laws, and a reusable training recipe. Ideas validated through this review can in turn become new baselines, and ArchSpace thereby aims to broaden the range of ideas that shape the next generation of models.

[NLP-1] Learning When Diffusion Language Models Should Regenerate

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型在推理过程中因局部错误无法被有效修正而导致整体输出质量下降的问题，尤其关注在扩散语言模型（diffusion language models）中如何实现高效且精准的文本修正。其核心挑战在于：模型难以准确判断何时需要重生成以及应修正的具体内容。通过对数独任务的诊断发现，隐藏状态中蕴含了错误信息，而仅依赖词元置信度难以可靠识别这些错误；此外，单独修正一个错误项往往会在上下文不变的情况下导致错误重复出现。针对上述问题，论文提出DiVR（Decision-based Verifier for Revision），一种能够预测部分生成序列是否能最终达成正确答案的验证器。DiVR通过学习模型自身轨迹的最终正确性进行训练，决策何时应重新生成某一段内容以及保留哪个替代方案，同时保持生成器本身不变。实验结果表明，在五个推理基准测试中，基于LLaDA-8B-Base的微调生成器在使用DiVR后，平均准确率从35.3%提升至43.4%，计算成本仅为贪婪解码的1.9–3.5倍，优于采用3.8–7.4倍计算开销的搜索基线方法。此外，DiVR可与监督微调、强化学习等后训练策略协同工作，并具备良好的泛化能力，适用于其他生成器如Dream。其关键创新在于将验证机制与生成过程解耦，实现了高效、自洽的纠错决策。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17320
作者: Minhae Oh,Jeonghye Kim,Jinwoo Koo,Yeongoon Kim,Jimin Seo,Minsik Seol,Jungwoo Lee
机构: Seoul National University(首尔国立大学); KAIST(韩国科学技术院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps. Hidden states contain error information that token confidence does not reliably expose, and remasking an isolated error usually reproduces it when the surrounding context remains fixed. These findings motivate DiVR , a verifier that predicts whether a partially generated sequence will reach a correct answer. Trained on the final correctness of the model’s own trajectories, DiVR decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to retain, while the generator itself stays unchanged. On five reasoning benchmarks with LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR raises the average accuracy of the fine-tuned generator from 35.3% to 43.4% at 1.9 - 3.5\times the cost of greedy decoding, above search baselines that use 3.8 - 7.4\times . It also complements post-training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and generalizes to other generators, including Dream.

[NLP-2] CoReMem: Cost-Internalizing Memory for Successive Coding Tasks with Prospective Valuation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决代码生成代理（coding agent）在动态演进的代码库中处理连续任务时面临的记忆管理难题：如何在未知下一任务的情况下，权衡记忆写入与读取的成本与未来效用，并决定何时利用已有记忆以降低任务执行开销。其核心解决方案是提出一种成本内化框架——代码库记忆系统（Coding-Repository Memory, CoReMem），通过量化记忆在下一任务中的潜在价值来指导记忆设计与智能体行为自适应。关键在于：1）前瞻性片段估值机制，通过对比包含或排除特定记忆轨迹片段的未来任务执行表现，识别具有高价值的记忆锚点（如代码库位置和可执行检查点），从而构建紧凑、高效的记忆结构；2）基于策略的内存价值估计，在回放组中对比启用与禁用记忆时的奖励表现，优先奖励任务解决率并惩罚成功运行中的步数；3）来源门控的价值归属机制，将额外收益仅分配给使用记忆提供的锚点的步骤，同时确保所有步骤均保留结果信用。实验表明，在ChainSWE基准上，CoReMem使27B规模智能体的解决率从21.0%提升至25.7%，平均减少17%的执行步数和11%的总缓存感知标记数（包括记忆模块调用），显著提升了记忆利用效率与任务求解能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17316
作者: Peiwen Li(Yale University),Harshit Verma(Yale University),Sophia Zhou(Yale University),Haiwen Wang(Yale University),Ngoc Bui(Yale University),Heng Chang(Tsinghua University),Fei Fei(Goodvision AI),David van Dijk(Yale University),Rex Ying(Yale University)
机构: Yale University (耶鲁大学); Tsinghua University (清华大学); Goodvision AI
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Coding agents tackle successive tasks on an evolving repository, carrying forward edits and writing memory before the next task is known. Selecting memory for unknown next tasks requires balancing future usefulness against the costs of writing and reading it. The actor must also decide when acting on available memory saves effort as the task unfolds. We introduce Coding-Repository Memory (CoReMem), a cost-internalizing framework that guides memory design and actor adaptation through measured memory value on the next task. Prospective segment valuation compares runs of the next task with and without individual trajectory segments from the same inherited repository state, guiding a compact memory built around anchors: repository locations and executable checks. Actor adaptation estimates on-policy memory value within rollout groups with and without memory, using a reward that prioritizes resolution and penalizes step count in successful runs. Provenance-gated value credit assigns the additional value term to steps identified as using memory-supplied anchors, while every step retains outcome credit. On ChainSWE, CoReMem raises the 27B actor’s resolve rate from 21.0% to 25.7%, with 17% fewer steps and 11% fewer total cache-aware tokens, including memory-module calls, relative to the untrained actor model without memory.

[NLP-3] Linking Rapid Learning to Compositional Structure in Neural Networks: Evidence from Additive Analogies in Meta-Learned Parameter Spaces

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决神经网络在有限经验下难以实现快速学习的问题，尤其关注如何通过优化网络结构使其具备类人般的快速学习能力。其核心挑战在于理解元学习（meta-learning）训练后的神经网络为何能高效适应新任务，以及其内部机制如何支持这种快速泛化。解决方案的关键在于揭示元学习网络中参数表示的可加性特征：研究发现，经过元学习优化的网络在学习不同函数时，其参数变化可被编码为向量形式，这些向量之间存在类似符号逻辑的可加减关系——即“函数表示向量”可通过线性组合重构出新的目标函数对应的参数配置。当将这些经符号运算生成的新参数向量直接应用于网络时，网络无需额外训练即可正确实现预期函数，表明元学习通过调整初始参数空间中的几何布局，引导后续学习沿功能上合理的轨迹进行，从而为神经网络引入可解释的归纳偏置（inductive bias），提供了从几何层面理解快速学习机制的新范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17314
作者: Abigail L. Tenenbaum,R. Thomas McCoy
机构: Yale University (耶鲁大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 24 pages plus references and appendices

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Humans can learn rapidly from limited experience, while neural networks typically require extensive training. In this work, we investigate what properties of a neural network can enable it to learn rapidly. We study neural networks that have been optimized via meta-learning, a technique that exposes a network to many related functions to facilitate its subsequent learning of similar functions. Prior work has shown that these meta-learned networks can learn new functions rapidly, but how they do so remains unclear. To investigate their internal structure, we take inspiration from classic work demonstrating additive relationships among the learned vectors that neural networks use to represent words (e.g., “king” minus “man” plus “woman” approximates “queen”). Analogously, we look for additive relationships among a meta-learned network’s “representations” of different functions; when a meta-learned network rapidly learns to implement a specific function, all of its adapted parameter values can be concatenated into a single vector that we treat as representing the function. We find that such parameter vectors can be added and subtracted according to symbolic relationships among the functions they represent, yielding new parameter vectors that successfully represent the functions predicted by the corresponding symbolic manipulations: the networks specified by these artificially recombined vectors actually implement the intended functions without any direct training on them. Our results suggest that meta-learning can tune a network’s starting point to organize subsequent learning along systematic, functionally meaningful trajectories through the space of possible parameter vectors, providing a geometric basis for realizing inductive biases in neural networks.

[NLP-4] Goal Encoding in LLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）如何编码和维持目标（goal）这一核心问题，特别是探究模型是否具备内化的、可引导行为的动态目标表征，并在多步骤任务中实现灵活的目标选择与执行路径。其关键解决方案在于：通过构建包含多个子任务的编码场景，发现并定位到少数注意力头（attention heads）中存在对下一子目标的神经编码；这些注意力头不仅能够编码目标信息，还能解码出模型未来以自然语言表达的动作意图（如“我正在检查一个词是否为回文”），且该编码具有因果性与可塑性——将其移植至不同环境（如另一编程语言）仍能触发相同操作，仅表现为不同的标记序列。此外，尽管基于Transformer的模型不具备递归机制，无法长期保存状态，但模型仍能在整个动作执行过程中持续维持目标编码，这引发对传统状态传递机制的质疑。为此，作者提出非递归目标寻求（Non-Recurrent Goal-Seeking, NRGS）理论框架，认为模型并非依赖内部状态延续目标，而是通过频繁重读任务说明，结合上下文进展进行实时比对，持续推进未完成的目标。研究通过有针对性的因果干预验证了该理论预测，揭示了LLMs在无显式记忆机制下实现目标导向行为的关键机制。

作者: Arnab Sen Sharma,Eric Todd,Sheridan Feucht,Andy Arditi,Rohit Gandikota,Natalie Shapira,Gabriele Sarti,Constanza Fierro,Lisa Schut,David Bau
机构: Northeastern University(东北大学); Parallax(帕拉克斯); University of Copenhagen(哥本哈根大学); University of Oxford(牛津大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

Abstract:We investigate whether and how LLMs encode goals: internal neural representations that precede and guide action, and that are flexible enough to be realized through many different execution paths. We construct a coding setting with multiple sub-tasks that allows us to evaluate goal-seeking behavior and the selection of sub-goals. In this setting, we localize an encoding of the next sub-goal in the outputs of a sparse set of attention heads. The same heads can be used to decode the LM’s future actions in natural language (e.g., “I’m checking if a word is a palindrome”). We verify that this encoding is causal for next action and is plastic: transplanting it into a different environment, e.g., another programming language, triggers the same operation realized with a different sequence of tokens. The LM also sustains the encoding throughout the action’s execution, which is puzzling because a transformer LM without recurrence cannot carry a state forward for more tokens than it has layers left. We propose that it does not need to. Under a non-recurrent goal-seeking (NRGS) account, the LM frequently re-reads the goal from the task specification, compares it with the progress visible in the growing context, and pursues what remains. We test the predictions of this account with targeted causal interventions.

[NLP-5] Metal Sandbox: Isolated Execution and Command Scheduling for GPU Coding Agents on Apple Silicon

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在设备端推理（on-device inference）中，本地加速器（local accelerators）利用率低的问题，尤其是在使用Apple Metal进行模型生成与执行时，因并发任务调度不畅导致GPU资源大量空闲。其核心解决方案是提出Metal Sandbox，一个基于多台互联Mac设备的分布式基础设施，通过限制性实例级文件访问、原生命令执行以及跨节点命令级调度机制，实现对开发环境的隔离与高效协同。每个代理（agent）保持独立的工作空间和私有开发环境，支持并行命令的并发执行与串行命令的共享执行槽，并允许等待中的可迁移命令自动转移到空闲的Mac上执行，从而显著提升系统吞吐量。结合Harbor的集成实现了任务执行、自动验证与滚动部署收集的统一工作流。实验表明，在四台Mac mini M4节点上，集中负载下命令吞吐量提升1.68×至2.05×；基于16个静态代理轨迹的模拟显示，每节点运行四个会话相比单会话可实现2.14×的持续吞吐量增益；动态调度策略进一步将平均工具等待时间降低18.8%，批处理总耗时减少22.3%。该方案已开源于GitHub。

Abstract:On-device inference requires kernels that make effective use of local accelerators. Efficient training and evaluation of models that generate Apple Metal kernels benefit from native macOS tools and concurrent agent sessions. These sessions alternate between model requests, development commands, and GPU execution, leaving GPU capacity idle for much of a rollout. We present Metal Sandbox, infrastructure that combines restricted per-instance file access, native command execution, and command-level scheduling across interconnected Macs. Each agent retains its workspace and private development environment. Parallel commands can run concurrently, while serial commands share one execution slot per node; eligible waiting commands can migrate to available Macs and return results to the original agent. Integration with Harbor supports task execution, automatic verification, and rollout collection through a common workflow. Controlled experiments on four Mac mini M4 nodes achieve 1.68\times – 2.05\times gains in command throughput under concentrated demand. Sixteen static agent traces give an estimated 2.14\times sustained-throughput gain for four sessions per node versus one, assuming continuously replenished sessions and unchanged mean durations. Replaying these measured traces under dynamic scheduling reduces mean tool waiting by 18.8% and batch elapsed time by 22.3%, assuming unchanged phase durations. Metal Sandbox and its Harbor integration are open-source on GitHub.

[NLP-6] Negative-Only Policy Optimization for One-Sided Verifiable Rewards NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在缺乏完全可验证奖励（complete verification）的现实场景中，强化学习与可验证奖励（Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards, RLVR）方法因存在单向可验证性（One-Sided Verifiability, OSV）而产生的可靠性问题。在OSV设定下，仅能可靠验证错误解（即被证实为错误的样本是可信反例），而通过部分检查的正样本（verified positives）可能仍包含大量假阳性，导致标准RLVR方法在奖励正样本时容易误激励绕过完整验证的捷径策略。针对此问题，论文提出负样本抑制型策略优化（Negative-Only Policy Optimization, NOPO），其核心在于将验证通过的正样本视为未标注数据，仅通过对可信负样本进行抑制来更新策略。NOPO采用基于参考对比的负样本抑制损失，并引入群体级适配器，根据非被否定响应的比例动态缩放更新强度，从而有效缓解假阳性干扰。实验表明，在代码、逻辑与数学基准测试中，当无法获得真实奖励（oracle rewards）时，NOPO在单位测试、约束检查及大语言模型自验证等不同验证机制下均显著优于基线方法，且在推理阶段扩展和跨基准迁移中仍保持性能优势。

作者: Jiacheng Xu,Shuo He,Fuxiang Zhang,Chaojie Wang,Bo An
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Spotlight)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically relies on a verifier that can reliably judge whether sampled solutions are correct. However, in many realistic settings, complete verification is generally unavailable, while cheap checks can only falsify failures. We formalize this regime as one-sided verifiability (OSV): verified negatives are reliable counterexamples, but verified positives are merely non-falsified candidates and may contain many false positives. This asymmetry makes standard RLVR unreliable, because reinforcing verified positives can directly reward shortcuts that pass partial checks. To address this issue, we propose Negative-Only Policy Optimization (NOPO), which treats verified positives as unlabeled and updates the policy only by suppressing trusted verified negatives. Specifically, NOPO combines a reference-relative negative suppression loss with a group-level adapter that scales each update by the proportion of non-falsified responses. Across unit-test, constraint-check, and LLM self-verifiers, NOPO improves pass@k over baselines on code, logic, and math benchmarks when oracle rewards are unavailable. These gains persist under inference-time scaling and cross-benchmark transfer.

[NLP-7] Synthesis Smuggling: Maliciously Hiding Inferred Personal Attributes in LLM Outputs

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在用户交互过程中可能通过隐写技术（steganography）间接泄露敏感个人信息的问题。其核心威胁在于：攻击者训练的恶意大语言模型（LLM）能够从用户日常求助性对话中推断出性别、年龄组等敏感属性，并将这些信息以不可见字符或特定词汇选择等方式隐秘嵌入生成内容中，使用户在无意间成为信息传播载体。解决方案的关键在于揭示了即使模型本身无法直接与外部攻击者通信，其输出仍可通过普通共享渠道（如邮件、社交媒体）构成隐蔽信道（covert channel），从而实现对用户隐私的非直接但高效的窃取。这一发现凸显了生成内容中潜在的隐写风险，为安全评估和防护机制提供了重要警示。

类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

Abstract:We propose Synthesis Smuggling, a novel threat model in which an adversarial LLM infers sensitive information about a user from routine assistance-seeking interactions and steganographically encodes that into innocuous-looking model-generated content. The user may then unknowingly transmit that information by sharing the generated artifact, say as an email, social-media post, or message, through ordinary communication channels. An adversary monitoring these channels can discover this information. We demonstrate this threat by training two open-weight models to infer gender and age-group labels from conversational cues and encode their predictions using invisible characters or word choices. These results show that user-shared model outputs can become a covert channel for personal inferences, even when the model itself has no direct means of contacting an adversary.

[NLP-8] Maximizing Capacity Utilization of LoRA Adapters for Mitigating the Learning-Forgetting Trade-off

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决低秩适应（LoRA）在异构（heterogeneous）和持续学习（continual learning）场景中性能不足的问题，其核心挑战在于存在显著的“学习-遗忘权衡”（learning-forgetting trade-off）。研究发现，传统LoRA适配器（尤其是高秩设置下）无法充分利用配置的秩容量，表现为实际有效秩远低于设定秩，导致更新能量分布受限，影响模型泛化能力。为此，论文提出一种关键解决方案：在语言建模损失中引入一种简单、稳定、可微且无需奇异值分解（SVD-free）的Rényi-2有效秩正则项（effective-rank regularizer），以在优化原始目标的同时最大化适配器的有效秩。该方法通过显式提升有效秩，实现了学习与记忆之间的更优平衡，在多个模型、多随机种子的跨领域实验中均验证了其有效性——当正则权重λ=0.01时，所有测试秩≥16的条件下，平均维基百科困惑度均有降低，而训练困惑度变化不超过0.02。此外，研究还揭示若干现有LoRA变体同样存在容量利用不足问题，表明有效秩不仅是适配器质量的后验诊断指标，更可作为可训练的目标来优化学习-遗忘边界。

Abstract:Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) often underperforms full fine-tuning, especially in heterogeneous and continual-learning settings in which substantial forgetting occurs. In general, it suffers from an undesirable learning-forgetting trade-off across diverse fine-tuning settings. We identify a potential contributor: LoRA adapters, especially high-rank ones, frequently fail to realize the available capacity afforded by the configured rank. Specifically, we find that standard LoRA updates have effective rank far below their configured rank, limiting how broadly the update energy is distributed. Therefore, we propose training mechanisms that optimize the original objective while maximizing adapter effective rank. Our main method adds a simple, stable, differentiable, and SVD-free Rényi-2 effective-rank regularizer to the language-modeling loss. We also connect capacity maximization to norm-bounded updates. In mixed-domain rank sweeps on three models evaluated with multiple random seeds, a penalty weight of \lambda=0.01 lowers mean Wiki perplexity at every tested rank of at least 16 relative to unpenalized LoRA. Mean training perplexity improves or increases by at most 0.02 in all but one model-rank comparison. Single-task and scheduling experiments further show that the balance between learning and retention depends on the configuration. We also observe that several LoRA variants in the literature also suffer from the identified capacity issue, and our approach provides a complementary axis of improvement to LoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning. These results suggest that effective rank is not only a post-hoc diagnostic of adapter quality, but a trainable objective for improving the learning-forgetting frontier. Our code is available at this https URL

[NLP-9] Parsed Plausible Wrong: Output Format Controls Silent Errors in Small-Model Semantic Parsing

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在自然语言理解任务中因输出格式设计不当而导致的“沉默错误”（silent errors）问题，即小型微调解析器虽生成语法正确但语义错误的树结构时，下游系统无法察觉此类错误。其核心问题是：输出格式作为自由设计选择，是否显著影响此类错误的发生频率？解决方案的关键在于采用基于普通词汇（word encoding）的输出表示形式，相较于传统的s表达式（s-expression）等编码方式，该方法在保持模型性能的同时大幅减少令牌数量（降低4.1倍），并在两个子十亿级模型（Qwen3.5-0.8B 和 LFM2.5-350M）上分别实现87.5%和85.8%的精确匹配率，显著降低沉默错误率（分别下降2.3倍和1.8倍）。关键发现是，仅通过缩短输出长度无法提升鲁棒性，而将目标树以自然语言词汇形式编码则能有效提升准确性，尤其在否定句处理方面表现突出。此外，模型还学会拒绝菜单外输入并进行内部自修正，尽管严格拒绝策略导致2.1%-10.1%的真实、礼貌订单被误拒。

Abstract:A small fine-tuned parser that emits a well-formed but wrong tree fails silently: nothing downstream can tell. We ask whether the output format, a free design choice, controls how often this happens. On the PIZZA ordering benchmark we fine-tune two sub-billion models (Qwen3.5-0.8B and LFM2.5-350M) with LoRA on six lossless encodings of the same target tree, from 44.3 down to 10.9 tokens per order, including two matched-length pairs that vary surface form at fixed length. Across 300 runs (5 training pool sizes, 5 seeds) with a hierarchical bootstrap and Holm correction fixed before the results were read, shortening alone never helps, but writing the target in ordinary words does. The word encoding is the most accurate format on both models (87.5% vs. 85.8% exact match for the native s-expression on Qwen) while emitting 4.1x fewer tokens, and it cuts the silent error rate by 2.3x on Qwen and 1.8x on LFM2, separating at every pool size. Error analysis locates much of the gain in negation. All runs also learn to refuse off-menu input (held out: 95.9-99.0% handled) and to apply in-utterance self-corrections. Strict refusal has a measured price: 2.1-10.1% of real, mostly polite, orders are refused.

[NLP-10] Actor Judge or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在强化学习中的角色定位问题，即：一个表现不佳的决策模型（decision model）是否仍具备有效的教学能力。传统研究通常以决策模型作为“行动者”（actor），并以其行为表现作为评估标准，而本文提出新视角——考察决策模型作为“评判者”（judge）或“教师”（teacher）的能力。其解决方案的关键在于：在任务执行完成后，通过全局轨迹评估来判断每一步动作的实际贡献，而非仅依赖对最终任务成败的预测。研究发现，即使作为行动者的模型因优先选择易实现子目标而偏离正确路径，但当其作为评判者时，能够准确识别出真正有助于达成核心目标的动作序列。实验表明，基于这一机制的教师模型JEV可显著提升策略性能，在ALFWorld和WebShop任务中分别将策略成功率从72.8%和56.8%提升至82.9%和71.4%。这说明，有效教学不依赖于行动者本身的优秀表现，而是依赖于事后对动作后果的精准评估能力。

Abstract:Decision models answer a question with a typed output, such as a choice among options with a probability for each, so one model can choose an agent’s actions, evaluate actions already taken, or score every action to teach a policy with reinforcement learning. Prior work has studied them mainly as actors, judging their usefulness by how well they act. We ask whether a decision model that acts poorly can still teach well. We compare three decision models and three general LLMs as actors and judges on ALFWorld, and use JEV as a teacher on ALFWorld and WebShop. As actors, all six models are pulled away from a subgoal that must come first by an easier one. As judges that see the whole trajectory, the same models credit the steps toward that subgoal, and asking whether each action helped, rather than whether the task will succeed, separates useful from useless actions. As a teacher, JEV raises a Qwen2.5-1.5B policy over GRPO from 72.8% to 82.9% success on ALFWorld and from 56.8% to 71.4% on WebShop. These results suggest that a poor actor can still teach well, because judging an action after the episode ends reveals the consequences that acting must anticipate. Code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-11] Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation: Differentiable Length Control for Concise Clinical Reasoning in Smaller Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决小型语言模型（Small Language Models, SLMs）在临床自然语言处理任务中生成回答过于冗长的问题，这一缺陷限制了其在临床决策支持与即时诊疗场景中的实用性，即使模型推理正确，过长的输出也难以快速解读和应用。现有长度控制方法依赖于偏好优化、奖励模型或专有教师模型，这些方法削弱了SLMs在低成本硬件上部署的可访问性优势。本文提出参数高效简洁性适配（Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation, PECA），其核心创新在于在QLoRA监督微调目标中引入一个可微的简洁性项：当生成序列超过预设的词元预算时，通过提升结束序列（end-of-sequence）的概率来形成平滑的优化信号，从而引导模型生成更短的回答。该方法无需偏好数据、无需辅助模型，仅需单块消费级GPU即可完成训练。实验表明，在17亿参数的模型上基于medical-o1-reasoning-SFT语料微调后，PECA使平均响应长度减少72.8%，同时将多项选择诊断准确率从40.8%提升至44.0%。对简洁性强度的系统性扫描揭示了一条可解释的准确率-长度权衡前沿，为临床场景下简洁性与诊断完整性之间的平衡提供了实用依据。

Abstract:Smaller language models (SLMs) make it feasible to deploy clinical natural language processing where large proprietary models are too costly, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning allows them to be specialised on commodity hardware. One obstacle persists after training: on medical tasks these models answer at far greater length than the clinical question requires. In clinical decision support and point-of-care use, where time is short, such verbosity is hard to act on even when the underlying reasoning is sound. Existing length-control methods depend on preference optimisation, reward models, or proprietary teachers that undercut the accessibility making SLMs attractive. We introduce Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation (PECA), which adds a single differentiable conciseness term to the QLoRA supervised fine-tuning objective. Because the token count is discrete and non-differentiable, PECA instead raises the end-of-sequence probability once generation exceeds a token budget, a smooth signal optimised during ordinary training, with no preference data, no auxiliary model, and a single commodity GPU. On a 1.7-billion-parameter model fine-tuned on the medical-o1-reasoning-SFT corpus, PECA reduces mean response length by 72.8% while improving multiple-choice diagnostic accuracy from 40.8% to 44.0%. A sweep over the conciseness strength traces an interpretable accuracy-to-length frontier for balancing brevity and diagnostic completeness.

[NLP-12] CapLite: Prompt-Injection Defense for Small Language Model Agents without Model-Written Security Artifacts

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前生成式AI（Generative AI）系统中提示注入攻击（prompt injection attack）的防御机制有效性问题，特别是针对依赖智能体自身小语言模型（SLM）生成安全凭证（如策略、依赖图、约束列表或程序代码）的防御方案（如CaMeL、Progent、IPIGuard和DRIFT）的可信性问题。研究发现，15个开源权重的小语言模型（参数规模在1.7B至12B之间）中，有13个所生成的安全凭证存在可被利用的漏洞，导致其对应的防御机制在11至14个模型上失效，且部分方案（如CaMeL）在高达68%的运行周期中因生成代码无法执行而失败。为解决这一问题，论文提出CapLite，其核心创新在于：基于工具模式（tool schemas）构建策略，强制在读取工具结果前提交所有写操作，并仅当写操作的目标对象、接收者、金额或目的地等关键参数均明确包含于用户原始请求时才允许执行。该机制确保了写入完整性，防止注入文本新增写操作，且任何写操作均无法作用于用户未明示的实体。在13,935次受攻击的AgentDojo测试中，CapLite实现了零成功攻击，同时在攻击环境下保持与CaMeL相当的实用性（29.0% vs. 27.2%），且每轮任务仅消耗17.1k tokens，仅为CaMeL的18%，并成为所有防御方案中单位令牌效率最高的方案。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17115
作者: Zimo Xu,Wenzhuo Liu,Hideki Nakayama
机构: The University of Tokyo(东京大学); Institute of Automation, CAS(中国科学院自动化研究所)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)
备注: 19 pages, 11 figures, 9 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Enforcement defenses against prompt injection, such as CaMeL, Progent, IPIGuard and DRIFT, ask the agent’s own model to write a security artifact (a program, a privilege policy, a dependency graph or a constraint list) that code then enforces. We ask whether small language model (SLM) agents can be trusted to write these artifacts. Across 15 open-weight models, 13 of them between 1.7B and 12B parameters, they cannot: the policies, graphs and constraints that the agent’s model writes admit attacks on 14 (Progent), 13 (IPIGuard) and 11 (DRIFT) of the models, and CaMeL’s programs fail to run in up to 68% of episodes. We present CapLite, which derives its policy from the tool schemas, commits the write calls before any tool result is read, and admits a write only if every argument that decides whom or what it affects is stated in the user’s request. This guarantees write integrity: injected text cannot add a write, and no write reaches a recipient, amount, object or destination that the user did not state. No attack succeeds in 13,935 attacked AgentDojo episodes. CapLite reaches utility under attack comparable to CaMeL’s (29.0% vs. 27.2%) with fewer tokens than every other enforcement defense and than the undefended agent: 17.1k per episode, 18% of CaMeL’s, and the highest utility per token of all enforcement defenses.

[NLP-13] LazyWeights: Decode-on-Demand Edge LLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决边缘设备上大语言模型（LLM）部署中的内存容量与带宽瓶颈问题，特别是现有量化格式（如GPTQ、AWQ及K-和I-quants）在编码时对矩阵中每个整数代码均分配相同比特数，导致压缩效率低下，无法充分利用权重分布的非均匀性。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为“LazyWeights”的新型轻量级解码机制：在保持原有量化格式兼容性的前提下，通过优化GPTQ使权重代码可被高效压缩，并采用霍夫曼编码（Huffman coding）对编码后的数据进行无损压缩，且以交错通道方式存储；解码操作由位于DRAM与L2缓存之间的小型专用单元按需执行，确保GPU核无需修改即可运行，同时仅传输编码后的字节，显著降低内存访问开销。实验表明，在1%与3.5%困惑度预算下，采用该方案的Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B和SmolLM-1.7B模型体积比最优原始格式缩小5.7%至31.4%；基于7nm工艺的0.21 mm²位精确ASIC解码单元可将Jetson Orin Nano Super的每令牌延迟和能耗分别降低最多36%和38%（结合提示查找推测后可达54%和44%），而在Jetson Nano上，该方案相较传统CPU实现减少58%-64%时间与53%-57%能耗，并以3.89比特/权重的极低精度流式运行Mistral-7B，速度提升达6.6倍。此外，霍夫曼解码器在同等吞吐率下表现优于算术编码器（rANS），且该ASIC模块可在Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA（AMD ZCU102）上实现位精确运行，验证了其实用性与硬件适配性。

Abstract:Memory decides which LLMs an edge device runs, and how fast: capacity on a 4 GB Jetson Nano, bandwidth on an 8 GB Jetson Orin Nano Super. Deployed formats (GPTQ, AWQ, \textttthis http URL 's K- and I-quants) spend equal bits on every integer code of a matrix, although the codes are far from uniform. \textttLazyWeights keeps these formats but tunes GPTQ so the codes compress, Huffman-codes them losslessly in interleaved lanes, and decodes them on demand in a small unit between DRAM and L2, so GPU kernels run unchanged and DRAM moves only coded bytes. At 1% and 3.5% perplexity budgets, coded Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B and SmolLM-1.7B are 5.7-31.4% smaller than the best \textttthis http URL format. A bit-exact 0.21 mm ^2 ASIC decoder unit ( 1 GHz, 7 nm) cuts Orin latency and energy per token by up to 36% and 38% ( 54% and 44% with prompt-lookup speculation). On the Nano, \textttLazyWeights needs 58-64% less time and 53-57% less energy per token than CPU \textttthis http URL , and runs a streamed Mistral-7B 6.6 \times faster at 3.89 bits per weight. A Huffman decoder beats an rANS decoder in rate and area at equal throughput; the ASIC decoder unit runs bit-exact on a Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA (AMD ZCU102).

[NLP-14] Disentangling Spurious Correlations: How IRM Handles Diverse Shortcuts in Text Classification EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自然语言处理（Natural Language Processing, NLP）中基于经验风险最小化（Empirical Risk Minimization, ERM）训练的模型易受虚假相关性（spurious correlations）干扰的问题，这些相关性如方言标记等非鲁棒语言特征会损害模型在分布外（out-of-distribution, OOD）场景下的泛化能力。其核心挑战在于如何识别并抑制此类捷径依赖，以提升模型对真实因果关系的建模能力。解决方案的关键在于采用因果驱动框架，系统评估不变风险最小化（Invariant Risk Minimization, IRM）在多种捷径生成机制（包括标签生成特征、混淆因子及选择偏差）下的有效性。研究发现，无论是在受控的合成数据还是更贴近实际应用的复杂场景（如“生物医学中的性别-职业关联”和“演员名称的语义化捷径”），IRM均能有效识别并消除虚假相关性，尤其在环境变化有限或标签噪声增加的情况下仍具稳健表现；同时指出，对于具有语义意义的真实特征，需通过精细调节不变性惩罚项的权重以实现最优性能。

Abstract:In NLP, models trained via Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) often exploit spurious correlations, such as dialectal markers, at the expense of robust linguistic features, thereby degrading their out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. Invariant Risk Minimization (IRM) aims to suppress such shortcuts by identifying predictive relationships that remain stable across environments, but its practical utility for NLP remains debated. We use a causality-driven framework to evaluate IRM under three shortcut-generating mechanisms: label-generated features, confounding, and selection bias. Our results show that IRM successfully rejects shortcuts across the evaluated causal and anti-causal structures, including under limited environmental variation and increasing label noise. We then extend our analysis beyond controlled synthetic artifacts to two less constrained settings: gender-profession associations in Bias in Bios and semantically loaded actor-name shortcuts in ActorCorr. These experiments show that invariant learning can mitigate more realistic textual shortcuts, while semantically meaningful features require careful calibration of the invariance penalty.

[NLP-15] Optimal Single-History Tokenization Disambiguation for Provably Secure Linguistic Steganography

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决可证明安全的语义隐写术（provably secure linguistic steganography）在实际文本信道中因分词歧义导致信息提取失败的问题。现有方法要么改变词频分布、依赖全词汇池同步（在大词汇量下容量崩溃）、或需维护多历史轨迹，均存在效率或可行性缺陷。其核心解决方案是提出**“硬币投影”（coin projection）**——一种基于共享随机性的闭式方案，通过在前缀森林中固定停止决策（stop decisions），在保证精确无误提取的前提下，使单历史接收端仍能维持最大可能的隐藏信息容量。该方法的关键在于：证明了在全支持语言模型下，若提取完全正确，则接收端在每一步只能访问一个前缀自由（prefix-free）候选集，且必须放弃“停止熵”（stop entropy，即决定每个前缀是否终止的熵）。通过共享随机性对停止熵进行约束，硬币投影在仅需单次模型调用生成每令牌的情况下，实现了理论容量上限，兼容任意分布编码器，并保留标准采样特性，同时显著优于现有方案如SyncPool。实验表明，在英、中、日文语境下，尽管文本歧义极低（最多千分之十一），但停止熵占每步总熵的7.2%-9.0%，而硬币投影可保留91%-93%的字符串熵，相较SyncPool在全词汇量下提升2.16-6.85倍的信息承载能力，且确保所有完整消息均可恢复。

作者: Feng Jiang
机构: Hangzhou Dianzi University (杭州电子科技大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)
备注: 19 pages, 4 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Provably secure linguistic steganography assumes that the receiver recovers the sender’s tokens, but a text channel delivers only text, and ambiguous tokenizations break extraction. Existing fixes change the distribution, synchronize whole pools of tokens at a capacity that collapses with large vocabularies, or track several token histories. We prove that if extraction is exact and error-free across full-support language models, a single-history receiver is confined to a prefix-free candidate set at every step – even if it reads the entire future text and the sender constrains later steps – and must therefore give up the stop entropy, the entropy of deciding whether each prefix token ends there. Fixing these stop decisions on the prefix forest with shared randomness yields coin projection: a closed-form scheme that attains the bound, works with any distribution coder in one model call per token, preserves ordinary sampling, and refines SyncPool for every key. Across English, Chinese and Japanese, ambiguous text is rare (at most 11 in 1,000 tokens), yet the stop entropy at word and morpheme prefixes takes 7.2-9.0% of the entropy at every step; SyncPool’s further loss comes from space and single-byte UTF-8 hubs that merge subtrees while carrying almost no stop uncertainty. Coin projection keeps 91-93% of the string entropy for the coder at every vocabulary size; with the full vocabulary, it turns 2.16-6.85 times as much entropy into message bits as SyncPool and recovers every completed message.

[NLP-16] Reasoning Supervision and Capability Retention in LoRA Domain Adaptation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在金融数据上微调基础模型时如何提升特定任务性能的同时保持模型泛化能力的问题。其核心挑战在于避免因微调导致模型通用能力的退化。解决方案的关键在于对比三种不同的低秩适应（LoRA）训练策略：仅基于响应的微调（response-only LoRA）、单适配器推理链训练（single-adapter reasoning）以及双适配器复合训练（dual-adapter composite training）。实验结果表明，响应仅微调在域内性能提升显著，尤其在校准性和argmax准确率方面表现最优，且对模型通用性影响最小；引入教师模型推理链虽使MMLU-Pro略有提升，但整体域内指标仍落后于响应仅微调方案；双适配器复合训练未带来进一步增益。此外，通过压缩教师推理链为摘要形式进行训练，可使校准性能向响应仅微调靠拢，但仍未能完全达到其水平，验证了推理链信息压缩的有效性与局限性。

Abstract:Fine-tuning foundation models on financial data has a wide range of applications, including identifying event types from news, monitoring risk and compliance language, and answering questions over filings and earnings calls. In this setting, the main challenge is to improve task performance without degrading the generalization capabilities of the model. In this paper, we present an extensive set of ablations for fine-tuning Qwen3-8B with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We compare three training regimes: (1) response-only LoRA, where the supervised response is the label alone; (2) single-adapter reasoning, where reasoning traces from a teacher model are included alongside the labels in the training loss; and (3) dual-adapter composite training, where separate LoRA adapters are trained on traces and labels. Response-only LoRA improves in-domain performance and leaves general capabilities near those of the frozen model. The in-domain change is largest for calibration and argmax accuracy. Under single-adapter reasoning, the in-domain metrics remain behind those of the response-only regime, while MMLU-Pro can rise slightly and the other retention benchmarks stay within ordinary variation. Dual-adapter composite training remains on the same side of this comparison and yields no further gain. Finally, we compress the teacher traces by summarizing them before training, and show that shorter summaries move calibration toward the response-only regime without reaching it.

[NLP-17] Discovering Effective Agent Memory Designs through Program Evolution

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决智能体记忆设计（agent memory design）中人工设计效率低、性能受限的问题，尤其关注如何在保证高准确性的同时显著降低服务成本。其核心解决方案是提出MAPE框架，通过标准化生命周期接口与迭代诊断-提案循环，从极简种子程序出发自动演化完整的记忆程序。关键创新在于：1）发现并验证了两个普适的设计模式——保留原始对话作为可检索证据以维持细节信息，以及根据查询意图对检索到的证据进行语义组合，从而提升回答模型的利用效率；2）揭示了优化目标对计算资源分配的影响：在兼顾准确率与服务成本的前提下，将计算重心从基于大语言模型（LLM）的记忆构建转向查询时的精细化处理，实现性能与成本的平衡。实验证明，该方法在LoCoMo和LongMemEval基准上相较人工设计基线提升最高达12%的准确率，同时仅需35%的服务开销，并具备跨模型架构与任务的迁移能力。这些发现为智能体记忆系统的设计提供了可复用的实证指导。

Abstract:Program evolution provides a promising approach to discover agent memory designs and study the choices underlying their effectiveness. We introduce MAPE, a framework that evolves whole memory programs from minimal seeds through a standardized lifecycle interface and an iterative diagnosis-proposal loop. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval yield an absolute accuracy gain of up to 12% over manually designed baselines at 35% of the serving cost, with further evaluations supporting transfer across serving backbones and benchmarks. Empirical analyses and ablations identify and validate two recurring design patterns: retaining raw conversations as retrievable evidence preserves details omitted from extracted memories, while composing retrieved evidence according to query intent helps the answering model use it effectively. Transplanting the composition module into five existing memory systems improves accuracy across all five. Beyond these patterns, the search objective shapes where computation goes: optimizing serving cost alongside accuracy shifts computation from LLM-based memory construction to selective processing at query time while retaining competitive accuracy. Together, these findings offer empirical lessons for agent memory design. Code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-18] Evaluating Pretrained Language Semantics for Structured EHR Prediction Tasks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决结构化电子健康记录（EHR）模型在建模临床概念时忽视自然语言语义信息的问题，导致概念间关系主要依赖于EHR数据中的共现模式学习，而无法有效利用预先存在的语义知识。其解决方案的关键在于提出tEHR框架，通过将临床事件以自然语言描述形式表示，并基于此文本流进行针对EHR的持续预训练（EHR-adaptive continued pretraining），随后采用低秩适配（LoRA）进行任务特定的判别性微调，充分利用大语言模型（LLM）作为纵向患者编码器的能力。实验结果表明，tEHR在MIMIC-IV数据集上的四项预测任务及CPRD数据集上胰腺癌1至12个月的预测任务中均取得最优性能，且消融实验证明临床描述的完整性、数值信息的保留以及双阶段适应过程对模型表现至关重要，而显式的时间间隔描述则未带来显著增益。此外，对学习到的患者表征分析显示其具备与疾病风险和临床病史模式相对应的临床可解释结构。
